title: Google Opal Explained in 20 Minutes! in Hindi
description: In this video, I’ll show you how to use Google Opal, Google’s latest no-code AI tool, to build AI agents and automations using just natural language prompts — no coding required! Google Opal is a No Code platform currently in the experimental phase. In Google Opal, you just need to input a prompt and your mini AI apps will be generated. Google Opal take cares about your app's backend and frontend. In this video I gave the walkthrough of this platform. Also, I have created one mini app(gem) using Google Opal.
